info.name: ABL Backend — Full API
info.description:
Complete ABL API: auth, users, pricing, booking, assignment, trip lifecycle, cancellation & refunds, wallet, notifications, flight, chat, reports and admin.

**Run `npm run seed` first** — the seeded accounts all use the password `Passw0rd!23`.

Requests are ordered as a working flow, so "Run collection" exercises the whole system end to end. Every request asserts its result.

exec: pm.test("returns a token pair", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.accessToken).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(d.refreshToken).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("password hash never leaves the server", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.passwordHash).to.be.undefined);
pm.test("base fare, no peak", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.isPeak).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.fare).to.eql(100); });
pm.test("peak multiplier applied", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.isPeak).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.fare).to.eql(200); });

item.name: Fare estimate — subscriber pays flat rate in peak

exec: pm.test("subscriber avoids the uplift", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.subscriber).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.fare).to.eql(100); });
pm.test("drivers read trips, not bookings -> 403", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.name: UPDATE booking (before a driver is assigned)

exec: pm.test("assigned, busy, or too late", () => pm.expect([200, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test("paginated", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.items).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(d.total).to.be.a("number"); });
pm.test("receipt shape", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property("fare"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("tripType"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("status"); });

item.name: Trip as DRIVER — fare is stripped (note 2)
Trip as CUSTOMER — driver phone masked (note 4)

exec: pm.test("admin sees the real phone", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.driver.phone).to.not.eql("Contact via app"));

item.name: Cannot rate the same trip twice
Wrong cancellation endpoint for the trip type

exec: pm.test("trip is point2point, not hourly -> 400", () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
pm.test("90% refund granted", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.policy.refundPct).to.eql(90); pm.expect(d.refundAmount).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test("driver ledger does not leak the fare", () => { const rows = pm.response.json().data.transactions.items; rows.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.meta.ownerShare).to.be.undefined); });
pm.test("refund credited with NO fee (rule 3)", () => { const r = pm.response.json().data.transactions.items.find(t => t.type === "refund"); if (r) pm.expect(r.feeApplied).to.eql(0); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test("10% fee applied", () => pm.expect(d.feeApplied).to.eql(2)); pm.test("net payout 18", () => pm.expect(d.netPayout).to.eql(18)); pm.test("gateway payout recorded", () => pm.expect(d.payout.gatewayReference).to.be.a("string")); }

item.name: Customer applies wallet credit to a trip (no fee)

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test("zero fee on ride credit (rule 3)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.feeApplied).to.eql(0));
pm.test("flight shape", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.have.property("scheduledArrival"); pm.expect(d).to.have.property("status"); });
pm.test("scope all with totals", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.scope).to.eql("all"); pm.expect(d.totalFare).to.be.a("number"); });

item.name: Company: add a driver to the roster
Company: set the driver per-trip charge

exec: pm.test("terms recorded as set by the company", () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.payout; pm.expect(p.mode).to.eql("flat"); pm.expect(p.value).to.eql(30); pm.expect(p.setBy).to.eql("company"); });

item.name: Admin cannot set a company driver's terms

exec: pm.test("that driver is on a company's roster -> 403", () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
